title_en: Does sound travel faster in air or in water? #shorts
title_ko: 소리는 공기와 물 중 어디서 더 빠를까? #shorts
desc_en:
At 20 °C (68 °F), sound moves through air at about 343 m/s (≈1,125 ft/s). In fresh water it moves at about 1,480 m/s (≈4,860 ft/s): roughly 4.3 times faster.
Water is much harder to squeeze than air, so each push of a sound wave is passed along faster.
Paper cut-outs, moved entirely with code. For a wordless short film from the same studio, tap the related video below.

Source: OpenStax University Physics Volume 1, 17.2 Speed of Sound (openstax.org/books/university-physics-volume-1/pages/17-2-speed-of-sound)

desc_ko:
섭씨 20도에서 소리는 공기 속을 초속 약 343 m(약 1,125 ft/s)로 갑니다. 민물 속에서는 초속 약 1,480 m(약 4,860 ft/s), 약 4.3배 빠르죠.
물은 공기보다 훨씬 덜 눌려서, 소리의 떨림이 더 빨리 전해집니다.
